about: Product choices for Disruption Recovery plans: decisions, not facts about airports or airlines.
Ranking score in minutes (lower = better) = minutes later than the original arrival + changes of planes x stopPenaltyMinutes + extra cost / 1000 x minutesPerThousandInr.
NORMAL: an extra change of planes counts like arriving 3 h later, every 1,000 rupees extra like 10 min later (cost only counts for separate tickets).
URGENT: arrival dominates; a change of planes counts like 30 min, 1,000 rupees like 1 min.
Read by the backend's FileRecoverySettings and (from C3) the app; checked by RecoverySettings.problems().
